assets.prompt: The Storm Fork, a stray: a Wood staff with a crossbar and three prongs, each tipped in Acid (lightning) green, and an Acid ferrule. A 32x32 body with its ferrule at the bottom (row 28), 1px dark outline, light from the top-left; the face (eyes and brows) is a separate layer. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no player colours.
